question: Does the current canonical game expose a credible faction, seat, or authored-strategy dominance signal when opponent decision quality is separated into homogeneous and mixed backend regimes?

interpretation.homogeneousRegimes: Primary deterministic strategy diagnostic: every player uses the same decision implementation.
interpretation.alternatingRegimes: Backend-interaction diagnostic; a greedy policy beating a stochastic policy is not by itself a rules defect.
interpretation.rulePromotion: No rules value changes without a later preregistered one-lever common-seed probe, tracked receipt, synchronized surfaces, and explicit user approval.
interpretation.physicalBoundary: No automated result establishes teachability, negotiation quality, Realignment drama, perceived fairness, duration, or fun.
